raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: The first filtered list of “Daniel Craig movies under 150 minutes” was incomplete/incorrect, omitting major qualifying titles like Casino Royale (144 min, ~8.0), Skyfall (143 min, ~7.8), Knives Out (130 min, ~7.8–7.9), and Glass Onion (139 min, ~7.1, a Netflix title). This flawed candidate set led subsequent availability checks and the final conclusion astray. WebSurfer then asserted “Road to Perdition” as the highest-rated on Netflix US without presenting evidence of its US availability, compounding the initial filtering error.
